item.text:
<linkedin_post>Thrive Holdings has acquired ADT for about $7.6 billion in equity, with a total enterprise value of $15.3 billion. The firm plans to make ADT the foundation of its smart home security business.

OpenAI is both an investor in and a partner to Thrive Holdings, supplying its companies with AI models, technology and engineers. Thrive says it holds more than 75 companies and intends to own them for the long term while applying AI to their businesses.

The companies have said they will invest in new products, but have not announced what those products will be. ADT already partners with Apple and Google and is expected to continue those relationships, even as large technology companies expand their own smart home security offerings.</linkedin_post>
